triggers: the 'Caveats' technique is being considered on NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100)

payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): Caveats
payload.what: - TMEM double-buffering requires that the accumulator fits in half the TMEM columns (256 out of 512). For very wide tiles (TILE_N > 256 with FP32 accumulators), the tile must be split or a different buffering strategy used. - SMEM multi-stage buffering is constrained by the 228 KB SMEM limit. With 3 stages of large tiles, there may not be enough SMEM left for epilogue scratch space. - The mbarrier synchronization between TMEM buffers adds a few cycles of overhead per tile. For kernels with very few K-iterations per tile, this overhead is proportionally larger.
